subject_uz: Chorvachilik obyektlarini ichimlik suvi bilan ta'minlash uchun suv inshootining loyiha-smeta hujjatlarini ishlab chiqish

requirements.summary_uz: Narpay tumanidagi 18 ta chorvachilik obyektini ichimlik suvi bilan ta'minlaydigan suv inshooti uchun loyiha-smeta hujjatlarini ishlab chiqish.
requirements.summary_en: Prepare design and cost-estimate documents for a water facility supplying drinking water to 18 livestock facilities in Narpay district.
requirements.quote: suv inshooti qurish obyekti uchun loyixa smeta xujjatlarini ishlab chiqish

requirements.summary_uz: Bajarish muddati qisqa bo'lsa ko'proq ball beriladi: 15 kundan ortiq muddat deyarli ball bermaydi, 10 kungacha 20 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Shorter completion time earns more points: over 15 days earns almost nothing, up to 10 days earns 20 points.
requirements.quote: 15 kundan ortik muddatga 0 baldan 1 ballgacha = 1.0; 13 kundan 15 kungacha – 10 ball = 10.0

requirements.summary_uz: Hujjatlardagi kamchiliklar uchun javobgarlik va ularni bepul qayta ishlab chiqish haqida kafolat xati taqdim etish (15 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Submit a guarantee letter to be liable for defects in the documents and to redo them free of charge (15 points).
requirements.quote: Bajaruvchi loyiha-smeta hujjatlari kamchiliklar uchun, shu jumladan keyinchalik qurilish jarayonida

requirements.summary_uz: Kafolat xati taqdim etilsa 15 ball, etilmasa 1 ballgacha beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: A guarantee letter earns 15 points; without it at most 1 point.

requirements.summary_uz: Diplomli injener-texnik xodimlar (bosh muhandis, bosh arxitektor va boshqalar) mavjudligi tasdiqlanishi kerak (20 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Diploma-holding engineering staff (chief engineer, chief architect, etc.) must be shown (20 points).

requirements.summary_uz: Moddiy-texnik baza (ofis texnikasi, kompyuterlar, geodeziya asboblari) kadastr hujjati yoki ijara shartnomasi bilan tasdiqlanadi (15 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Material and technical base (office equipment, computers, surveying instruments) is evidenced by a cadastre document or lease contract (15 points).
requirements.quote: bino-inshoot kadastr hujjati nusxasi yoki ijara shartnomasi nusxasi

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy va kadrlar resurslari mavjud bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must have the technical, financial, material and staff resources needed to perform the contract.
requirements.quote: Шартномани бажариш учун зарур техник, молиявий, моддий, кадрлар ресурсларининг ҳамда бошқа ресурсларнинг мавжудлиги.

requirements.summary_uz: Soliq va yig'imlar bo'yicha muddati o'tgan qarzdorlik bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: No overdue tax or fee debt.
requirements.quote: Солиқлар ва йиғимларни тўлаш бўйича муддати ўтган қарздорликнинг мавжуд эмаслиги.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi insofsiz ijrochilarning yagona reyestrida bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must not be on the single register of unfair suppliers.
requirements.quote: Инсофсиз ижрочиларнинг ягона реестрида қайд этилмаганлиги.

documents_needed_uz: Soliq qarzdorligi yo'qligi va insofsiz ijrochilar reyestrida qayd etilmaganligi to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma
Hujjatlardagi kamchiliklar uchun javobgarlik va bepul qayta ishlab chiqish haqida kafolat xati
Diplomli injener-texnik xodimlar, loyiha bosh muhandisi va bosh arxitektori haqida ma'lumot, diplom va buyruq nusxalari
Moddiy-texnik baza bo'yicha ma'lumotnoma (kadastr hujjati yoki ijara shartnomasi, geodeziya asboblari)
